title: Pair validity run bound
statement: Let $x$ and $r$ be finite bit strings. For every prefix $p$ such that $x$ is the concatenation of $p$ and $r$, there is a time $t \\le |r|+1$ such that the constructed machine, started in its initial scanning state with input head immediately after $p$ and empty output, has halted by time $t$ and output the one-bit indicator of whether the pair parser succeeds on $r$.
